content.text: What Each Option Actually Offers: Online gumroad

Gumroad caters primarily to creators in supported countries, providing a straightforward platform for selling digital products. However, this comes at the cost of limited geographical reach, often excluding major markets like Nigeria and Pakistan. Stripe, while robust with extensive features, operates in only 46 countries, leaving many creators to navigate the complexities of international commerce without support. COREMERCH, on the other hand, provides a comprehensive infrastructure that allows any digital creator to set up an online store with no geographical restrictions, enabling creators to take full control of their sales without dependence on any single platform.
How They Handle Restricted Countries

Platforms like PayPal and Gumroad often dismiss entire countries due to regulatory concerns, which creates a significant barrier for creators looking to sell their products online. A PayPal account suspension can hold funds for up to 180 days without the possibility of appeal, creating financial uncertainty. In contrast, COREMERCH's sovereign infrastructure is built explicitly for creators in these restricted regions, providing a reliable alternative that is not only accessible but also designed to thrive in challenging financial landscapes. This architecture ensures that creators can focus on their work rather than worrying about payment processing limitations.
Payment Speed, Fees, and Real Costs

Traditional platforms frequently impose high transaction fees and slow payment processing times, particularly in countries that they deem high-risk. Stripe's fees can add up, especially when dealing with currency conversion and international transactions. In comparison, COREMERCH utilizes NOWPayments for crypto transactions, charging only a 0.5% fee with instantaneous payment confirmations. This means that creators can expect immediate access to their funds without the long waiting periods typical of conventional payment processors, allowing for a more efficient cash flow and better financial management.
Ownership of your data means you control your future.
Ownership, Automation, and Delivery

When creators rely on platforms like Gumroad, they often give up significant ownership over their content and customer data. These platforms can impose restrictions on how products are delivered and managed. COREMERCH's model ensures that once the infrastructure is set up, creators own everything — the data, the products, and the customer relationships. With automated delivery systems in place through tools like Cloudflare Workers and Supabase, creators can streamline their sales without ever losing sight of their ownership or control over their own intellectual property.
Which Architecture to Choose Based on Your Situation

For creators situated in regions with severe payment restrictions, the Edge Commerce Stack ($197) from COREMERCH is an ideal solution. Deployed in 48 hours, it offers a robust combination of Cloudflare Pages, Workers, and Supabase, enabling creators to effectively manage up to five products with ease. Whether you are looking to sell ebooks, courses, or digital assets, this infrastructure provides a permanent solution that circumvents the limitations imposed by mainstream platforms, ensuring that you can reach your audience with minimal friction.
How do I sell digital products if Stripe is not available in my country?

Platform restrictions are not a customer service problem — they are an infrastructure problem. You cannot solve an infrastructure problem by calling support or finding the right contact at Stripe or PayPal. You solve it by building on infrastructure that was not designed around those restrictions in the first place. NOWPayments operates on blockchain rails — it has no correspondent banking relationships, no AML corridors to approve, and no geographic risk model that flags your country. It verifies transactions on-chain and fires a webhook. Your Cloudflare Worker or Apps Script receives the webhook and processes the order. The entire sequence is independent of any conventional financial institution.
Immediate payment processing with low fees transforms cash flow.

The search for platform alternatives ends when you stop looking for a better platform and start building infrastructure you own. The Edge Commerce Stack at $197 deploys Cloudflare Pages, Workers, Supabase, and NOWPayments under your accounts in 48 hours — no platform relationship involved at any layer after setup. The Sovereign Blueprint at $47 gives you the complete build documentation for both stacks if you prefer to deploy yourself. Either path results in a store that cannot be restricted by any payment platform's geographic coverage decision. See both options at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Stop using a friend's account in another country — this violates platform terms and puts both accounts at risk. Create a NOWPayments merchant account under your own email — no KYC required, takes under 15 minutes. Configure wallet addresses for USDT on Tron as your primary coin and Bitcoin as your secondary. Deploy your backend — Cloudflare Worker or Apps Script Web App — and confirm the endpoint URL is accessible. Set the endpoint URL as the webhook URL in your NOWPayments IPN settings with the secret key configured in both places. Build or deploy your storefront on Cloudflare Pages or GitHub Pages. Run a mainnet test transaction — send a small amount of real USDT to your configured address, confirm the webhook fires, the order logs, and the delivery email arrives. Promote your store only after the complete test passes.
